Iola (Whitlock) Brubeck was born in 1923 in Corning, California. She met Dave Brubeck when they were both students at the College of the Pacific in Stockton, CA. They will celebrate 70 years together in 2012. Iola’s contribution to Dave’s career and legacy are significant and ongoing. As their oldest son, Darius, stated, “She was and is, on every level, the anchor and the organizer.”
Iola was interviewed in Wilton, Connecticut on July 17, 2011, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am in the Brubeck residence in Wilton, Connecticut, and I’m very, very pleased to have Iola Brubeck with me today for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College.
